description: This file defines a static utility class 'ImageValidators' for validating image files based on size and extension within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi' namespace. It includes methods to check if a byte array represents a valid image file and whether the file extension is permissible.

classes.name: ImageValidators
classes.description: A static class providing methods to validate image files based on size and extension.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates if the provided byte array represents a valid image file with appropriate size and extension.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is one of the supported image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
